decisions.reason: Requiring a green level-4 graphic bullet changes visual appearance but does not change Tab-key behavior or hierarchy alignment.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that includes the green level-4 bullet in required_style_additions.
The visual specification for a green level-4 bullet does not change the legacy copy-paste stability requirement.
The new bullet appearance detail does not alter the assessment process, time budget, coverage, or required report outputs.

The green bullet specification is distinct from the requirement to include the templates' theme-color palette; the source message's separate theme-color clause is already represented in this candidate's history.
The level-4 bullet color and variant do not change manual line-break behavior after pasted content.
The graphic bullet appearance change does not affect table positioning or stability within page margins.
The green level-4 bullet requirement does not change whether interactive fields require persistent help labels.
The bullet color and level variant do not change typography; the source message's separate image/table text typography clause is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
